entities.name: Query shikimate kinase
observations: The 274-residue sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q9V1H6 from Pyrococcus abyssi.
Predicted molecular weight is 29.3 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.34.
The sequence contains a GHMP_kinases_N domain (Pfam PF00288.33) at residues 59–147.
The protein is assigned shikimate kinase activity, EC 2.7.1.71, with ATP binding and cytoplasmic localization by exact reference annotation.

entities.name: Shikimate phosphorylation
observations: Shikimate + ATP → 3-phosphoshikimate + ADP + H(+), Rhea RHEA:13121; this is the fifth step of chorismate biosynthesis.

entities.name: Chorismate biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme participates in chorismate biosynthesis from D-erythrose 4-phosphate and phosphoenolpyruvate, specifically step 5 of 7.
The pathway supplies precursors for aromatic amino acid biosynthesis.

entities.name: Archaeal cytoplasm
observations: Reviewed reference proteins from Pyrococcus abyssi, Pyrococcus furiosus, and Thermococcus gammatolerans are annotated as cytoplasmic.
